test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate pair of words to fill in the blanks.

Shyam has reserved a ________ in the train for his wife as she will be giving ________ to his child soon.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"berth"** means a fixed bed or bunk on a ship, train, or other means of transport. (बर्थ)

 
 
• **Example: **He reserved a lower berth for the overnight journey.
 
 
 
• **"Birth" **refers to the act or process of being born; the beginning of life as a physically separate being. (जन्म)
 
 
• **Example: **She is excited about the birth of her first child.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct words are **"berth" and "birth".**

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: birth; berth**

 
 
• **birth** (जन्म): The act or process of being born.

 
 
• **Example: **The birth of a child is a joyful event.
 
 
 
• **berth** (बर्थ): A fixed bed or bunk on a ship, train, or other means of transport.
 
 
• **Example: **She was assigned an upper berth on the train.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Option 3: birth; birth**
 
 
• **birth** (जन्म): The act or process of being born.
 
 
• **Example: **The birth of twins is always a special occasion.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Option 4: berth; berth**
 
 
• **berth** (बर्थ): A fixed bed or bunk on a ship, train, or other means of transport.
 
 
• **Example: **He was happy to get a lower berth for the journey.
